_source: Descriptions and materials for all four activities are transcribed from the real CDC 'History Teaching Module, Form 1 - Term 1' (2025), Sub-topic 1.1.1: Reasons for Learning History, Specific Competence 1.1.1.1. The 'foundational', 'requires_special_aids', and 'style_tags' labels are this app's own curatorial tags for the guided Q&A engine (Stage 5) — not official CDC designations.

activities.description: Explaining the meaning of History using an old building or object associated with the past within the school or its vicinity — learners research and discuss why it mattered then and why it matters today.
activities.materials: An old building within the school or surrounding area; blank pieces of paper

activities.description: Describing past events in the family (funerals, weddings, outings) using a table of important family events and why each mattered.
activities.materials: Chart showing a table of important events in the family

activities.description: Describing the importance of past events in small groups, each group discussing a different document about why past events matter, then reporting back to the class.
activities.materials: Flashcards; written documents showing the importance of past events; pictures of past events

activities.description: Showing the importance of history in different fields (medicine, law, music, sport, agriculture) using field-specific records and pictures, then identifying other fields where history matters.
activities.materials: Hospital records; court rulings; pictures of sports events; pictures/charts of agricultural implements; computers; charts of transport and communication
